race.comment: GRAFFITI TYCOON (8) exciting gelding undefeated in two starts this preparation. Smashed the clock at Randwick when he rounded them up late from the wide draw over 1300m. Massive jump in grade and can race much closer from the good gate today. Drops 5kg in weight and can continue the winning momentum. THEBELMONTGANGSTER (6) raced without luck in tougher races this time in and can race a touch closer here from the sticky draw. Drifted back along the inside and chipped away late when fourth over 1400m at Rosehill. Gets one more chance at the good each way odds. ANNIE'S ROSE (3) far from disgraced in the G3 Nivison two back, then gave away a big start when fifth over 1200m at Rosehill. Best figures measure up nicely and should run the trip. HANAU (4) launched late at the big odds for a slick victory over 1400m at Warwick Farm. Will appreciate the claim again and is a must for the exotics. BELLA KHADIJAH (7) capable mare on her day who looks ready to show up with the claim.
